description: Enable (ACTIVE) or pause (PAUSED) up to 20 campaigns, ad squads or ads in one go. Previews unless confirm=true: shows each change, skips ones already in that state, warns when a parent is paused, and for ACTIVE shows the daily budget that would really start delivering (refused above the configured limits). Stops at the first failure and reports exactly what changed. Never deletes. Two steps: confirm=false returns a preview and an approval_token; to apply, repeat the same arguments with confirm=true and that approval_token.

approval_token.description: The approval_token returned by the preview of this exact request. Required with confirm=true.

confirm.description: false = preview only (nothing sent). true = apply; needs approval_token from the preview.
